title: Proxy-Reliance Control in Conformal Recalibration of One-Sided Value-at-Risk
abstract: arXiv:2603.22569v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce a proxy-reliance-controlled conformal recalibration framework for one-sided Value-at-Risk (VaR), and study a question that existing state-aware methods do not usually isolate: how strongly should the recalibration adjustment depend on an imperfect volatility proxy? We formalize this through a proxy-reliance parameter that continuously interpolates between an approximately constant-shift correction and a fully proxy-scaled correction. This makes proxy reliance a distinct and practically interpretable design choice in one-sided VaR recalibration.   We show theoretically that larger proxy reliance increases the responsiveness of the tail adjustment to proxy scale, but also increases stressed-state fragility when the proxy underreacts. translated_title: 单侧风险价值保形再校准中的代理依赖度控制
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种面向单侧风险价值（VaR）的代理依赖度可控的保形再校准框架，并研究了现有状态感知方法通常未曾单独隔离探讨的一个问题：再校准调整应当在多大程度上依赖于一个不完美的波动率代理？我们通过一个代理依赖度参数将这一问题形式化，该参数在近似常数偏移修正与完全代理缩放修正之间进行连续插值。这使得代理依赖度成为单侧VaR再校准中一个独立且具有实际可解释性的设计选择。我们在理论上证明，更大的代理依赖度会增强尾部调整对代理规模的响应性，但在代理反应不足时也会加剧压力状态下的脆弱性。在实证方面，通过在包含VIX关联状态变量的六只ETF面板上进行滚动样本外测试，并辅以SPY的支持性证据，我们发现代理依赖度控制的实证价值……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在单侧VaR保形再校准中引入一个可调节的“代理依赖度”参数，理论证明更高的代理依赖度虽能提升尾部调整对波动率代理的响应性，但会在代理反应不足时放大压力状态下的脆弱性，从而将代理依赖度确立为一个独立且可解释的设计选择。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a tunable proxy-reliance parameter into conformal recalibration of one-sided VaR, showing theoretically and empirically that greater reliance on an imperfect volatility proxy improves tail-adjustment responsiveness but amplifies fragility in stressed states when the proxy underreacts, thereby making proxy reliance a distinct and interpretable design choice.
